metadata.title: First-order asymptotic expansions for spectral convergence of normalized graph Laplacians constructed from samples on manifolds
metadata.abstract: Under i.i.d. uniform sampling from a closed Riemannian manifold embedded in Euclidean space, we derive first-order asymptotic expansions for the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of symmetrically normalized graph Laplacians constructed via Gaussian kernels and provide concentration inequalities for the remainder terms. As a direct consequence, we establish the corresponding weak convergence results. Unlike most related works, our analysis does not impose a multiplicity-one assumption on the eigenvalues, thereby extending the applicability of the framework to general manifolds with potentially nontrivial eigenvalue multiplicities.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 从欧氏空间中嵌入的闭Riemannian流形独立同分布均匀采样，构造Gaussian核的对称归一化图Laplacian。作者给出特征值与特征向量谱收敛的一阶渐近展开和余项集中不等式，并推导相应弱收敛结果，允许极限特征值具有非平凡重数。
techniques: 概率余项集中与弱收敛
analysis.breakthrough: 无需把极限谱限定为单特征值，可在有重数的流形谱上研究一阶随机波动。
analysis.limitations: 采样须为闭嵌入流形上的独立均匀样本。重特征值如何选择或对齐特征向量、核带宽区间和极限分布的具体形式需查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 图Laplacian到流形谱的定量极限直接关联流形学习和离散几何分析。
